parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: The sphere is the main part of the globe, made of plastic, representing the Earth's surface with printed maps. It is approximately 25 cm in diameter.
parts.Functional_description: It displays the geographical features of the Earth and can rotate around its axis for educational and reference purposes.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate smoothly around the supporting axis attached to the base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the supporting structure of the globe, made of plastic, consisting of a stand and an arm that holds the sphere in place.
parts.Functional_description: It provides stability to the globe and supports the rotational mechanism of the sphere.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while allowing the sphere to rotate freely around its axis.
